verdict.rationale: Featurebase offers workflow/automation features (SLAs, trial extensions, auto-notifications on ship) and webhooks that let backend systems react to events, which supports rule-based, event-triggered automation. However, there's no evidence of a user-facing rule-builder UI (e.g., 'if X then Y' conditions) beyond a few named built-in automations, and no docs detail the range of triggerable actions or custom logic. missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose rules/conditions engine, list of supported trigger events and actions, evidence of custom automation configuration beyond webhooks and a few named workflows.
